style: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original photorealistic fruit catalog image made exclusively for the Rumila children's learning app. Square 1:1 image, high resolution, premium natural studio food photograph appearance. Seamless matte warm ivory background #FFF9EE, matching tabletop with no horizon. One compact fruit arrangement centered, occupying 72% of image width and 62-72% of image height, with at least 12% empty margin on every edge. Camera three-quarter front view, 15 degrees above tabletop, 85mm product lens, all fruit sharply in focus. Large softbox upper left, gentle fill right, delicate short contact shadow below, neutral accurate colors. Real botanical shape, believable tiny skin pores, natural imperfect texture, realistic flesh and seeds. No text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, plate, basket, hands, people, scenery, packaging, border, decorative props, cartoon features or plastic CGI gloss. Every fruit fully visible, never cropped. Keep the composition simple and consistent across a 48-image educational series.

subjects.pisang: Banana (Pisang). Two ripe naturally curved yellow bananas joined at their short brown-green crown, plus one short banana section at the front right revealing creamy pale flesh with tiny seed specks. No bowl, no peel strips scattered around. Natural faint brown freckles, full fruit visible.
subjects.mangga: Mango (Mangga). One whole elongated Indonesian ripe mango, green-yellow skin with subtle orange blush, beside one lengthwise cheek cut with smooth golden orange juicy flesh. A thin pale seed is not exposed in the cheek. No decorative leaf.
subjects.jeruk: Orange (Jeruk). One whole ripe orange with finely pitted orange peel and a tiny natural stem scar, beside one clean cross-cut half angled toward camera showing accurately radial juicy orange segments and thin white pith. No leaf.
subjects.apel: Apple (Apel). One ripe red apple with subtle natural yellow streaks and a short brown stem, beside a neatly cut apple half in front showing creamy white flesh, the central core and a few brown seeds. No leaf.
subjects.semangka: Watermelon (Semangka). One whole oval green watermelon with darker irregular longitudinal stripes, beside one substantial triangular wedge showing bright red flesh, a white rind layer, green outer skin, and a few normal black seeds. Compact arrangement, no giant oversized wedge.
subjects.melon: Netted melon (Melon). One spherical Indonesian-style green-fleshed netted melon with pale beige fine cork netting over muted olive rind, beside one cut half showing pale green juicy flesh and seeds restricted to the hollow central cavity. No orange flesh; this must differ from orange-fleshed blewah.
subjects.pepaya: Papaya (Pepaya). One ripe elongated papaya with yellow-orange skin and a small natural green patch, beside one lengthwise half showing orange flesh around a long central hollow lined with small shiny black seeds. Fully framed.
subjects.nanas: Pineapple (Nanas). One whole ripe golden pineapple with realistic diamond eyes and a short spiky green leaf crown, beside one small thick wedge with yellow fibrous flesh and a pale core. Entire crown visible, generous top margin.
subjects.anggur: Grapes (Anggur). One compact small bunch of ripe purple grapes on a short woody green-brown branching stem, and one loose grape plus a clean half at the front showing translucent light green flesh. Natural delicate wax bloom; no leaves.
subjects.stroberi: Strawberry (Stroberi). One plump naturally heart-shaped red strawberry with small pale achenes inset in tiny dimples, green calyx, beside a cut strawberry half showing a pale core and red flesh. Realistic seeds on the outside, not holes.
subjects.alpukat: Avocado (Alpukat). One whole pear-shaped green avocado with subtly pebbled skin, beside a lengthwise half showing creamy pale yellow flesh shading green near the rind and one large round brown pit. No extra pits.
subjects.kelapa: Coconut (Kelapa). One mature brown fibrous coconut, outer green husk removed, beside one halved shell with thick white coconut meat and the hollow center visible. Accurate fibrous shell, no straw or liquid splash.
subjects.durian: Durian. One oval olive-green mature durian with sturdy pyramidal spikes, beside one opened rind section revealing two or three creamy pale-yellow lobes in pale inner compartments. Clear spikes but appetizing fruit, no decorative leaf.
subjects.rambutan: Rambutan. Two ripe red rambutans with flexible curved red hairs grading to yellow-green at their tips, beside one peeled rambutan resting in half its red hairy shell, revealing translucent white oval flesh. Natural, not a spiky hard shell.
subjects.manggis: Mangosteen (Manggis). One round deep purple mangosteen with thick green four-part calyx and short stem, beside one opened lower half-shell containing several plump white segmented flesh lobes. Thick purple rind, no red pulp.
subjects.salak: Snake fruit (Salak). Two teardrop-shaped whole salak with brown overlapping glossy dry snake-skin scales and pointed tips, beside one peeled fruit showing three ivory lobes and a dark brown seed partially revealed in one cut lobe. No spines.
subjects.duku: Duku (Lansium domesticum). Three small nearly round pale beige-yellow duku with tiny natural brown speckles, beside one peeled fruit cradled in a thick yellow rind half showing translucent milky-white segmented flesh. The fruits should be rounder than langsat. No longan-like exposed black eyeball seed.
subjects.lengkeng: Longan (Lengkeng). Three small spherical tan light-brown longan fruits with fine matte thin shells, plus one peeled white translucent fruit opened to show a single shiny dark brown-black round seed. No hairy skin. No grape bunch.
subjects.jambu-biji: Guava (Jambu Biji). One round slightly pear-shaped pale green guava with a small dried blossom end, beside one cut half revealing pink flesh with many tiny cream-colored seeds concentrated toward the center. Natural slightly bumpy skin, no leaf.
subjects.jambu-air: Water apple (Jambu Air). Two red-pink bell-shaped waxy water apples, narrow at the stalk and broad with lobed concave bottom, beside one lengthwise half showing crisp white airy flesh, a small central cavity and at most one small seed. Do not make it look like an ordinary apple or pear.
subjects.belimbing: Star fruit (Belimbing). One elongated yellow starfruit with five pronounced longitudinal angular ribs and subtle green rib edges, beside one thick cross-section that clearly forms a five-pointed star with translucent yellow flesh and a few flat brown seeds. No decorative leaf.
subjects.sawo: Sapodilla (Sawo). One oval russet-brown sapodilla with fine sandy skin, beside one cut half showing caramel-tan soft fine-grained flesh and two glossy elongated dark brown-black seeds. Not potato or kiwi, no fuzz.
subjects.sirsak: Soursop (Sirsak). One asymmetrically heart-shaped deep green soursop with short soft-looking curved protrusions, beside a cut portion exposing white fibrous juicy flesh and several shiny black oval seeds. Different from durian's hard dense spikes.
subjects.nangka: Jackfruit (Nangka). One whole elongated green-yellow jackfruit with densely pebbled small blunt points, beside one rind wedge showing golden yellow arils embedded around a pale fibrous core, with a few large tan oval seeds visible. Do not turn interior into orange citrus segments.
subjects.buah-naga: Dragon fruit (Buah Naga). One oval vivid pink dragon fruit with green-tipped outward curling leafy scales, beside one cut half with white flesh evenly dotted with many very small black seeds and a thin magenta rind. No pink flesh in this example.
subjects.markisa: Passion fruit (Markisa). One round purple passion fruit with subtly wrinkled mature peel, beside one open half showing a white inner rind and many dark seeds in glossy golden-yellow gelatinous pulp. Correct seed-filled hollow interior, no citrus segments.
subjects.srikaya: Sugar apple (Srikaya, Annona squamosa). One green heart-shaped sugar apple with clearly separated rounded polygonal skin segments, beside one opened half showing soft ivory creamy flesh divided into lobes around shiny dark elongated seeds. Not soursop spikes and not artichoke leaves.
subjects.kedondong: Ambarella (Kedondong). Two oval yellow-green kedondong fruits with smooth slightly speckled skin, beside one cut half revealing pale yellow crisp flesh around a single large fibrous woody pit with fibers radiating into the flesh. Not guava or mango.
subjects.jeruk-bali: Pomelo (Jeruk Bali). One large round slightly pear-shaped light green pomelo with pitted thick rind, beside one cut half showing very thick white pith and radial pale pink juicy segments. More substantial white pith than orange. No leaf.
subjects.jeruk-nipis: Lime (Jeruk Nipis). Two small round fresh green limes with naturally pitted glossy peel, beside one cut half showing pale yellow-green translucent segments and a thin white central core. Small round shape, not elongated lemon.
subjects.lemon: Lemon. One whole elongated bright yellow lemon with slightly pointed nipples at both ends and finely textured peel, beside one cut half showing pale yellow radial citrus segments and one or two cream seeds. No leaf.
subjects.pir: Pear (Pir). One yellow-green pear with a rounded broad bottom, a narrower curved neck and short brown stem, beside one lengthwise half showing creamy white flesh and a small core with a few brown seeds. Subtle natural lenticel speckles.
subjects.kiwi: Kiwifruit (Kiwi). One oval brown kiwi with fine short natural fuzz, beside one clean cross-cut half showing green flesh, a pale central oval core, radial pale lines and a ring of tiny black seeds. Hair remains on skin only.
subjects.kurma: Dates (Kurma). Three ripe amber-brown dates with natural wrinkled slightly glossy skins, beside one split lengthwise date showing dense caramel-colored flesh and a single long smooth brown grooved pit. No bowl, no dried raisins.
subjects.delima: Pomegranate (Delima). One whole round deep red pomegranate with the small crown-shaped calyx at its top, beside one opened half showing many ruby red translucent arils in chambers divided by pale cream membranes. No smooth watermelon pulp.
subjects.kesemek: Persimmon (Kesemek). One slightly flattened orange ripe persimmon with a broad green-brown four-lobed calyx, beside one cut half showing orange flesh and a subtle star-shaped center with only a few dark elongated seeds. No tomato seed pockets.
subjects.leci: Lychee (Leci). Two small oval pink-red lychees with bumpy leathery skins, beside one peeled fruit sitting in its half-shell showing translucent white flesh and one smooth chestnut-brown oval seed visible in a cut portion. No rambutan hairs.
subjects.plum: Plum. One rounded ripe deep-purple plum with a subtle seam and natural dusty bluish wax bloom, beside one cut half revealing golden amber juicy flesh and a single hard oval brown stone. No fuzz.
subjects.persik: Peach (Persik). One round peach with fuzzy yellow skin blushed red, a natural vertical seam, beside one cut half with warm yellow flesh, red staining near the center and one deeply grooved brown stone. No shiny nectarine skin.
subjects.cempedak: Cempedak (Artocarpus integer). One slender elongated yellow-brown cempedak with small blunt soft-looking skin bumps, beside one opened section showing dense golden orange fleshy arils with large oval seeds and a pale fibrous center. Narrower form and smoother smaller bumps than jackfruit.
subjects.langsat: Langsat (Lansium domesticum). Three small oval pale yellow langsat with thin subtly speckled skin on a tiny short connecting stem, beside one peeled translucent white segmented fruit resting in its thin peel. More oval and paler than duku. No longan-like black central eyeball seed.
subjects.matoa: Matoa (Pometia pinnata). Two oval brownish-red matoa with firm smooth subtly mottled shells, beside one opened half showing translucent white aril around a single large tan-brown seed. Distinct oval elongated fruit, no rambutan hairs, no lychee bumps.
subjects.blewah: Blewah, Indonesian muskmelon. One oval pale orange-gold melon with broad visible longitudinal grooves and muted green lines following the grooves, beside one cut half showing pale orange flesh and many cream seeds confined to the hollow central cavity. Smooth grooved rind, not a densely netted cantaloupe.
subjects.terong-belanda: Tamarillo (Terong Belanda). One egg-shaped red tamarillo with smooth thin skin and small brown-green stem, beside a lengthwise half showing orange-red flesh and two rows of dark reddish seeds embedded in glossy red jelly near the center. Not tomato or ordinary eggplant.
subjects.ceri: Cherry (Ceri). Two deep red cherries attached to long slender natural green-brown stems, beside one cherry half showing red flesh and a single small round tan-brown pit. Natural lustrous skin and tiny stem dimples. No leaf.
subjects.cermai: Star gooseberry (Cermai, Phyllanthus acidus). Three small pale yellow-green fruits shaped like flattened spheres with six to eight deep vertical ribs, beside a cut half with pale yellow flesh around a small hard central stone. No large translucent grape pulp, no ordinary gooseberry fuzz.
subjects.jamblang: Java plum (Jamblang or Duwet, Syzygium cumini). Three elongated oval ripe purple-black jamblang with smooth glossy skin, beside a cut half showing pale lavender-white flesh stained purple near the skin and a single oblong pale tan seed. Not round European plums.
subjects.jambu-bol: Malay apple (Jambu Bol, Syzygium malaccense). One plump oval to slightly pear-shaped deep crimson Malay apple, broader and less hollow than water apple, beside a lengthwise half showing thick crisp white flesh and one large round brown seed. Smooth waxy deep red skin, no apple star-shaped core.
